scope: SIMULATED paired development comparison; not holdout or physical validation
interpretation_limits: All scenes and the control acquisition were previously inspected; this is development evidence, not independent validation.
The candidate coordinates were chosen with knowledge of development scenes, so even a 9/9 result cannot replace reserved or physical validation.
Global Delaunay can join points across a discontinuity or occluded gap even when every triangle edge is <=0.10 m.
TIN support is interpolation support, not directly observed area.
Ideal center rays omit finite-zone optics, noise, multipath, registration error, and hardware effects.
A low net total error can result from cancellation and must be read with integrated absolute spatial error.
